Introducing Saved Views, available today for every customer on a paid plan. If you find yourself rebuilding the same filters, sorting, and grouping every time you check on a project, this one's for you. Now you can set up a list exactly the way you like it, save it, and return to it anytime with a single click.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a specific sprint, or keeping an eye on a teammate's workload, there's room to save every view that matters to you. And because great workflows are worth sharing, any view can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating it from scratch.

Saved Views is included at no extra cost across all paid plans, with no add-ons or upgrades required. It's a small change that saves real time every day.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
